title: Paired baseline admission omitted the declared MACA native family and kernel identity

verified_by.CPU_contracts: 95 passed, including the actual baseline-admission caller with native zero/two scratch pointers and wrong-count/wrong-kernel counterexamples
verified_by.scope: Admission replay only; no GPU or performance qualification

observation: The committed C550-2 runtime successfully compiled and sealed the FP32 pairwise_sqdist R1024 K1024 N64 starter with two native launcher scratch pointers. Run preparation then refused before author optimization or device evaluation: validate_paired_baseline called _hidden_pointers without codegen_arch or kernel_name, causing device_image to receive architecture=None. The retained artifact is a CLANG offload bundle; its Target already declares the xcore1000 codegen family independently of physical xcore1002 and Triton API architecture 80. A CPU regression through the actual baseline-admission caller reproduces the same refusal.
proposed_change: Pass the frozen lowering requirements' codegen_arch and kernel_entry_point to the existing native argument inspector, matching sealing. Keep Target fact ownership, artifact inspection, source/launch comparison and wrong-kernel/hidden-pointer refusals intact.
principles: P1 author syntax unchanged; P2 retain inspectable lowering facts; P3 no second architecture table; P4/P5/P7 reuse the existing native ABI inspector and its legality checks; P6 exercise the real admission caller for zero/two scratch pointers and owned counterexamples plus the unchanged Corpus; P8 inspect the exact declared native family without substituting a target.
promotion_disposition: Promote the Lab admission bug fix after retained-baseline replay and software gates. No new primitive, target capability or performance qualification; the original failed preparation remains failed.
